description: Look up genes in the Allen Brain Atlas gene catalog by symbol/acronym, name substring, or Entrez ID. AUTHORITATIVE for resolving a gene to the Allen internal gene id and organism that the atlas expression data is keyed on — note the atlas holds mouse and human as SEPARATE gene records with the same-but-differently-cased acronym (Gabra1 vs GABRA1), and the expression datasets attached to each differ. Use this before allen_expression_datasets.

acronym.description: Exact gene symbol, e.g. "Gabra1" (mouse) or "GABRA1" (human). Case matters for the exact match; matching is retried case-insensitively and the response says which casing hit.

name_contains.description: Substring of the gene name, e.g. "dopamine receptor". Case-insensitive.

organism.description: Filter results to "mouse", "human", or omit for both.

name: allen_search_genes
title: Allen Search Genes
